learning_outcomes.text: Perform descriptive statistical analyses of data sets.
Apply appropriate statistical treatments according to the nature of the statistical variables that make up a database.
Use a statistical package for the statistical treatment of databases and results of random phenomena simulations.
Recognize the main probability distributions, both discrete and continuous, along with general methods for calculating probabilities.
Use statistical tools to adequately estimate unknown parameters of statistical models proposed in engineering using point and interval estimation methods.
Learn statistical techniques that facilitate the decision-making process in uncertain environments.

syllabus_topics: Measures of position and dispersion. Absolute and relative frequencies. Graphical representations
Conditional probability, total probability, Bayes' rule and independent events
Density and distribution function. Median, mode, percentiles and moments
Discrete random variables: Uniform, binomial and Poisson. Continuous random variables: Uniform, exponential and normal
Joint, marginal and conditional distribution of discrete and continuous random variables
Introduction to sampling. Parameters and estimators
Sampling distribution of the mean, the difference of means and the proportion
Sampling distribution of variance and ratio of variances
Point estimation and properties of estimators. Mean square error
Introduction to confidence intervals. Types of intervals
Hypothesis testing. Introduction. Type I and Type II error. P-value and power. Types of tests

assessment_methods.method: In-person tests and/or experimental work reports

assessment_rules: A minimum grade of 5/10 is required for the long answer tests. All assessment activities are recoverable (resitable).
